1145.explanation: Have a SSV as secretary flagship equip a ★+4 Type 0 Recon Seaplane in the first slot and then proceed to scrap 8x Type 0 Recon Seaplane and 15x Torpedoes and have 4x Type 93 Passive SONAR, 2x New Model Aerial Armament Materials, 1x New Model Armament Material and 60x Development Materials (All resources and Materials will be consumed upon completion)

1148.name: 【対空兵装の拡充】94式高射装置の増加配備
1148.description:
旗艦「白雪改二」または「吹雪改二」第一及び第二装備スロットに「91式高射装置」を装備。
開発資材x16及び改修資材x4を準備。「91式高射装置」x3、「13号対空電探」x3を廃棄せよ！
1148.explanation: Have your secretary flagship Fubuki Kai Ni or Shirayuki Kai Ni equip two Type 91 AAFD in the first and second slot and then proceed to scrap 3x Type 91 AAFD, 3x Type 13 Air RADAR and have 16x Development Materials and 4x Improvement Materials (All resources and Materials will be consumed upon completion)

1151.name: 陸軍戦闘機及び海外戦闘機の増備
1151.description:
【工廠任務】「水上偵察機」x14、「中口径主砲」x12、「艦上爆撃機」x10を廃棄。開発資材x36、
「零式艦戦21型」x8、「零式艦戦32型」x4を準備せよ！(任務達成後、準備装備等は消費します)
1151.explanation: Proceed to scrap 14x Seaplane Recons, 12x Medium Caliber Main Guns, 10 Dive Bombers and have 36x Development Material, 8x Type 0 Fighter Model 21, 4x Type 0 Fighter Model 32 (All resources and Materials will be consumed upon completion)

1152.name: 【対潜戦力強化】海防艦対潜兵装の強化
1152.description:
旗艦海防艦の第一装備スロットに「三式爆雷投射機」(★+3以上)を装備。同第二及び第三スロット
にもそれぞれ同装備(★不問)を装備。開発資材x32を準備。「九四式爆雷投射機」x4を廃棄せよ！
1152.explanation: Have a DE as secretary flagship and equip her with a ★+3 Type 3 Depth Charge Projector in the first slot and two more (any level) in second and third slots and then proceed to scrap 4x Type 94 Depth Charge Projectors and have 32x Development Materials (All resources and Materials will be consumed upon completion)

1153.name: 【続：対潜戦力強化】対潜兵装のさらなる拡充
1153.description:
旗艦「日振型」または「鵜来型」の第一スロットに「三式爆雷投射機」(★+4以上)を装備。同第二
及び第三スロにも同装備(★不問)を。開発資材x64を準備。「九四式爆雷投射機」x4を廃棄せよ！
1153.explanation: Have an Hiburi-class or Ukuru-class as secretary flagship equip a ★+4 Type 3 Depth Charge Projector in the first slot and two more (any level) in second and third slots and then proceed to scrap 4x Type 94 Depth Charge Projectors and have 64x Development Materials (All resources and Materials will be consumed upon completion)

1154.name: 【新型対潜兵装開発】対潜噴進爆雷砲の開発
1154.description:
旗艦Lv.96以上の駆逐艦第一スロットに「三式爆雷投射機 集中配備」(★max)装備。同第二スロに
「12cm単装砲」(★+6以上)を装備。新型噴進装備開発資材x3準備。「三式水中探信儀」x6廃棄！
1154.explanation: Have a Level 96+ DD as secretary flagship equip a ★max Type 3 Depth Charge Projector (Concentrated Deployment) in the first slot and a ★+6 12cm Single Gun Mount in second slot then proceed to scrap 6x Type 3 Active Sonar and have 3x New Model Rocket Development Material (All resources and Materials will be consumed upon completion)

1155.name: 秋月型防空駆逐艦用兵装の拡充
1155.description:
旗艦の秋月型駆逐艦(Lv.70以上)の第一及び第二スロットに「10cm連装高角砲」を装備、同第三
に「94式高射装置」を装備。「12.7cm連装高角砲」x8を廃棄。新型砲熕兵装資材x2準備せよ！
1155.explanation: Have a Lv 70+ Akizuki-class as secretary flagship equip a a 10cm Twin High-angle Gun Mount in both her 1st ans 2nd slots and a Type 94 Anti-Aircraft Fire Director in 3rd slot and then proceed to scrap 8x 12.7cm Twin High-angle Gun Mount and have 2x New Model Gun Mount Improvement Materials (All resources and Materials will be consumed upon completion)

1158.name: 第三十二駆逐隊「早波」、改装準備！
1158.description:
第一艦隊に旗艦「早波」。他に第三十二駆逐隊3隻以上を配備して「九三式水中聴音機」「三式
水中探信儀」「九五式爆雷」x各5廃棄。「新型兵装資材」x1及び「三式爆雷投射機」x8用意せよ！
1158.explanation: Have Hayanami as your secretary flagship and three of Tamanami, Suzunami, Fujinami and Hamanami in your fleet then proceed to scrap 5x Type 93 Passive Sonar, 5x Type 3 Active Sonar and 5x Type 95 Depth Charge and have 1x New Model Armament Material and 8x Type 3 Depth Charge Projector (All resources and Materials will be consumed upon completion)

1159.name: 【工廠任務】量産航空機の改編
1159.description:
秘書艦に「鳳翔改二/戦」。九六式艦戦、零式艦戦21型、零式艦戦32型、三式戦 飛燕(無印)
を各x3廃棄。熟練搭乗員x1、開発資材x40、ボーキサイト4,000、家具コイン88,000を準備！
1159.explanation: Have Houshou Kai Ni/Sen as your secretary flagship and then proceed to scrap 3x Type 96 Fighter, 3x Type 0 Fighter Model 21, 3x Type 0 Fighter Model 32 and 3x Type 3 Fighter Hien and have 1x Skilled Crew Member, 40x Development Material, 4000x bauxite, and 88 000x Furniture Coins (All resources and Materials will be consumed upon completion)

1160.name: 【工廠任務】試製震電の艦戦型改二への改修
1160.description:
第一旗艦に「飛龍」改二以降、32駆改二及び「風雲改二」から計3隻以上を随伴配備。零式艦戦
52型及び紫電改二を各x5廃棄。新型航空兵装資材x2、試製 震電(局地戦闘機)★maxを用意せよ！
1160.explanation: Have Hiryuu Kai Ni/San as your secretary flagship and three of Fujinami Kai Ni, Hayanami Kai Ni, Hamanami Kai Ni and Kazagumo Kai Ni in your fleet and then proceed to scrap 5x Type 0 Fighter Model 52 and 5x Shiden Kai Ni and have 2x Aviation Material, 1x Prototype Shinden (LB Fighter) ★max (All resources and Materials will be consumed upon completion)

1161.name: 【工廠任務】新装備運用のための工廠整備【壱】
1161.description:
第一旗艦に「飛龍改二/改三」を配備。不要な「艦戦」「艦爆」「艦攻」を各9装備ずつ廃棄。
爆雷兵装x8、機銃兵装x8、中口径主砲x9、大口径主砲x7を廃棄！弾薬x8,800を用意せよ！
1161.explanation: Have Hiryuu Kai Ni/Kai San as your secretary flagship and then proceed to scrap 9x Carrier fighters, 9x Carrier dive bombers, 9x Carrier torpedo bombers, 8x Depth charge, 8x AA Guns, 9x Medium-caliber main gun, 7x Large-caliber main gun and have 8800x ammo (All resources and Materials will be consumed upon completion)

1162.name: 【工廠任務】新装備運用のための工廠整備【弐】
1162.description:
「零式艦戦52型」x6、「紫電一一型」x4、「12.7cm連装高角砲」x8、「46cm三連装砲」x2を廃棄。
新型兵装資材x2、さらにボーキサイト及び鉄鋼を各8,800を用意、必要な資材/機材を生産せよ！
1162.explanation: Proceed to scrap 6x Type 0 Fighter Model 52, 4x Shiden Model 11, 8x 12.7cm Twin High-angle Gun Mount and 2x 46cm Triple Gun Mount and have 2x New Model Armament Materials, 8800x steel and 8800x bauxite (All resources and Materials will be consumed upon completion)

1163.name: 【工廠任務】震電の噴式推進化
1163.description:
旗艦「飛龍改三」第一装備スロットに「震電改二(艦戦型改二)」(★max)を搭載。新型航空兵装
資材x3、新型兵装資材x4、開発資材x160、熟練搭乗員x1、ネ式エンジンx1準備せよ！
1163.explanation: Have your secretary flagship Hiryuu Kai San equip a ★max Shinden Kai 2 (Carrier-based Fighter Model Kai 2) in the first slot and have 1x Ne Type Engine, 1x Skilled Crew Member, 3x New Model Aerial Armament Materials, 4x New Model Armament Material and 160x Development Materials (All resources and Materials will be consumed upon completion)

1164.name: 【工廠任務】水雷戦隊新改装艦、改装準備！
1164.description:
第一艦隊に旗艦「玉波」。僚艦に「藤波」「北上」を配備して「三式爆雷投射機」x8、「三式水中
探信儀」x4、「12.7cm連装高角砲」x8廃棄。「新型兵装資材」x1及び「15.2cm連装砲」x4用意！
1164.explanation: Have Tamanami as your secretary flagship with Fujinami and Kitakami in the fleet then proceed to scrap 8x Type 3 Depth Charge Projector, 4x Type 3 Active Sonar and 8x 12.7cm Twin High-angle Gun Mount and have 1x New Model Armament Material and 4x 15.2cm Twin Gun Mount (All resources and Materials will be consumed upon completion)

1166.name: 続：装備の改修強化
1166.description: 工廠任務：「改修工廠」で「装備」のさらなる改修強化を実施せよ！

1167.name: 装備の改修集中強化
1167.description: 工廠任務：さらなる戦力強化のため、本日中に「改修工廠」で「装備」改修強化を連続三回実施せよ！
1167.explanation: Attempt equipment modernisation three times in one day.

1170.name: 既存装備活用による対空兵装の開発
1170.description:
第一艦隊旗艦に「北上改二/改三」を配備。「12.7cm連装高角砲」x12及び「8cm高角砲」x8、
「25mm三連装機銃」x4を廃棄。開発資材x36、弾薬x750、改修資材x8を準備せよ！
1170.explanation: Have Kitakami Kai Ni+ as secretary flagship and then proceed to scrap 12x 12.7cm Twin High-angle Gun Mount, 8x 8cm High-angle Gun and 4x 25mm Triple Autocannon Mount and have 36x Development Material, 750x Ammo and 8x Improvement Material (All resources and Materials will be consumed upon completion)

1171.name: 【限定拡張作戦】対潜装備の整理整頓！2026
1171.description:
「九四式爆雷投射機」x12、「九五式爆雷」x8、「九三式水中聴音機」x6を廃棄。さらに「南瓜」x2、
「三式爆雷投射機」x5、開発資材x30を準備せよ！(準備した装備・資材等は消費します)
1171.explanation: Proceed to scrap 12x Type 94 Depth Charge Projector, 8x Type 95 Depth Charge, 6x Type 93 Passive Sonar and have 2x Pumpkin, 5x Type 3 Depth Charge Projector, 30x Development Material (All resources and Materials will be consumed upon completion)
